sloka: न च प्रार्थयते कश्चिन् मनसा अपि वसुम्धराम् ।वने अपि वसतः तस्य बाहु वीर्य अभिरक्षिताम् ॥२-८८-२३॥
transliteration: na ca prārthayate kaścin manasā api vasumdharām ।vane api vasataḥ tasya bāhu vīrya abhirakṣitām ॥2-88-23॥

translations.english: No one, even in thought, would ever desire this kingdom, protected by the strength of his arms even while residing in the forest.
